**Finding: deviation (RENEWAL)** — Article IV, ¶p0049.

- **Issue:** After the 36-month Initial Period, the Agreement "may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor" — a unilateral, multi-year extension with no Licensee opt-out and no constraint on renewal fees. That is walk-away territory under the rule and fails the fallback (auto-renewal with ≤60-day notice window, uplift ≤5%). The mutual-extension language in sub-clauses II/III conflicts with, and does not cure, the Licensor option.
- **Redline (validated, preferred position):** successive 12-month renewals, non-renewal on 30 days' notice by Licensee, 60-day Licensor reminder, and renewal uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%; fallback of 60 days / 5% flagged in the comment.
